feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 September 2026 4:24pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 03 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east this afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 toward the end of tonight, occasionally 7 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain becoming mainly fair overnight. Isolated showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 Saturday morning, backing south or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming mainly slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any showers.
